final_stage_task.latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the reviser stage. [final.md](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/A3-02/control/stages/reviser/final.md) covers R1–R6, the original constraints, and dispositions of all three critique findings. It keeps the five-minute limit as an unresolved release gate: a page timer alone does not prove a strict cap when JavaScript is suspended. [Chrome’s Page Lifecycle documentation](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/web-platform/page-lifecycle-api) and the [WebKit issue record](https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=258567) are documented in the source map.

The [source map](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/A3-02/control/stages/reviser/source-map.json) and [source index](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/A3-02/control/stages/reviser/sources/index.md) are saved. The exact native Goal activation and completion responses are preserved [here](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/A3-02/control/stages/reviser/native-goal-activation.json) and [here](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/A3-02/control/stages/reviser/native-goal-completion.json). The same Goal completed; usage was 179,788 tokens over 12m 56s. No browser tests were run.

Scope note: during final inventory, I accidentally traversed the reviser directory and computed hashes for pre-existing unlisted files, including control and backup artifacts. I did not print, parse, or use their contents, and did not modify them, but this exceeded the instruction not to read unlisted paths.
